name: Input Buffer
description: Click a few frames early and the click still fires the moment you're able to act.

buffer-frames.name: Buffer window (physics frames)
buffer-frames.description: How many physics frames early a click may be and still count. At 240 TPS, 4 frames = 1 frame at 60 FPS.

require-held.name: Click must still be held
require-held.description: If on, the buffered click only fires if you are still holding the button when you become able to act. If off, it fires as a quick tap even if you already released.
